evals.prompt: Create an Angular attribute directive called `appHighlight` that changes the background color of any element on hover. It should accept an optional color input (default yellow) and use the modern `host` metadata approach, not @HostBinding/@HostListener. Make it work with Angular 21 standalone APIs.
evals.expected_output: A standalone directive using host: { '(mouseenter)': ..., '(mouseleave)': ... } with input() for color, proper selector naming [appHighlight]

assertions.name: uses_input_function
assertions.description: Uses input() function instead of @Input decorator

assertions.name: correct_selector
assertions.description: Uses attribute selector [appHighlight] not element selector

assertions.name: standalone_implicit
assertions.description: Does not explicitly set standalone: true (Angular 21 default)

evals.prompt: I need to create a custom structural directive in Angular called `*appRepeat` that repeats its template a given number of times and exposes the current index as an implicit context variable. Show me the full implementation using TemplateRef and ViewContainerRef with the modern inject() function.
evals.expected_output: Structural directive injecting TemplateRef and ViewContainerRef via inject(), creating embedded views with context, exposing $implicit for index

assertions.name: uses_inject_function
assertions.description: Uses inject(TemplateRef) and inject(ViewContainerRef) instead of constructor injection

assertions.name: exposes_implicit_context
assertions.description: Sets $implicit in the context to expose index to template

assertions.name: handles_changes
assertions.description: Clears and recreates views when input changes, or uses effect/setter

evals.prompt: I'm building an Angular component library and want to use the directive composition API (hostDirectives) to compose behaviors. I have a CdkTooltip directive and a CdkFocusable directive, and I want to create a ButtonComponent that composes both without the consumer needing to know about them. Show me how to expose specific inputs/outputs from the composed directives and how to add the directives to the host.
evals.expected_output: Component using hostDirectives: [{directive: CdkTooltip, inputs: ['tooltipText'], outputs: [...]}, {directive: CdkFocusable}] with proper input/output aliasing

assertions.name: exposes_inputs_outputs
assertions.description: Shows how to selectively expose inputs/outputs from composed directives

assertions.name: explains_aliasing
assertions.description: Demonstrates or mentions input/output aliasing for host directives

assertions.name: explains_composition_benefit
assertions.description: Explains why hostDirectives is useful (encapsulation, reuse without consumer awareness)

evals.prompt: I want to use NgOptimizedImage in my Angular 21 app for a product gallery. Show me: (1) how to set it up with the provider, (2) how to use it for both static and dynamic images with proper width/height/priority attributes, (3) how to configure a custom image loader for Cloudinary, and (4) what fill mode is and when to use it.
evals.expected_output: provideImgixLoader or provideCloudinaryLoader in app config, usage, custom loader function, fill mode for CSS-sized containers

assertions.name: provides_image_loader
assertions.description: Shows provideCloudinaryLoader or custom IMAGE_LOADER provider in app config

assertions.name: uses_ngSrc
assertions.description: Uses ngSrc attribute instead of src

assertions.name: shows_priority
assertions.description: Demonstrates priority attribute for LCP images

assertions.name: explains_fill_mode
assertions.description: Explains fill attribute for CSS-sized containers (no width/height needed)
